title: Langkawi vs Penang: Which Should You Visit?
verdict: Penang for most travelers (food, culture, value). Langkawi for beach resorts and duty-free relaxation. Do both with 7+ days.

categories.name: Beaches
categories.summary: Langkawi wins clearly — Pantai Cenang and Tanjung Rhu have clear water. Penang's Batu Ferringhi is murky and not ideal for swimming.

categories.name: Food Scene
categories.summary: Penang is one of Asia's best street food cities. George Town's hawker stalls are a food travel pilgrimage. Langkawi is adequate but not a food destination.

categories.name: Cultural Depth
categories.summary: Penang has UNESCO World Heritage George Town, clan jetties, Khoo Kongsi, Kek Lok Si, and street art murals. Langkawi is primarily resort infrastructure.

categories.name: Cost
categories.summary: Penang is 20-40% cheaper for accommodation and food. Langkawi compensates with duty-free alcohol and electronics.

categories.name: Getting Around
categories.summary: Penang has Rapid Penang buses and cheap Grab. Langkawi requires renting a motorbike or car -- no public transport.

categories.name: Family-Friendly
categories.summary: Langkawi edges it for young kids: calm beaches, Underwater World, Wildlife Park, cable car. Penang's Escape waterpark is great for older kids.

categories.name: Nature
categories.summary: Langkawi has the Kilim Geoforest mangrove tour and cable car/skybridge. Both have good nature; Langkawi's is more dramatic.

categories.name: Duty-Free
categories.summary: Langkawi is a duty-free island -- alcohol, electronics, and cosmetics are 30-50% cheaper than mainland Malaysia.

faq.question: Is Langkawi or Penang better for first-time Malaysia visitors?
faq.answer: Penang is the stronger first-timer pick for culture and food. Langkawi wins for beach resorts.

faq.question: How do you get from Langkawi to Penang?
faq.answer: Fly (45 min, RM 80-200) or ferry to Kuala Kedah + train to Butterworth + ferry (4-5 hours, RM 60-80).

faq.question: Which is cheaper, Langkawi or Penang?
faq.answer: Penang is cheaper overall. Langkawi has cheaper alcohol due to duty-free status.
